label: late-episode drop modulated by state reached, a1 history and run of stays/rewards
terms: (phase == D2) * ((tv("stay",-1)==1)*1.0+(tv("stay",-2)==1)+(tv("stay",-3)==1)+(tv("reward",-1)==1)+(tv("reward",-2)==1)+(tv("reward",-3)==1)) * (ep_trial/99.0)**4 ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) * (ep_trial/99.0)**4 ;; (phase == GO) * choice * (ep_trial/99.0)**4 ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (ep_trial/99.0)**4 ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (ep_trial/99.0)**4 ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 1) * (ep_trial/99.0)**4
explanation: Raw GRU candidate n of unit 2 sits near +1 and falls steeply in the last ~20 trials of the episode (timing alone R^2 0.77). Everything beyond timing is a modulation of that late drop, so every term is scaled by (ep_trial/99)^4. At D2 it is higher when S1 is reached and lower when S2 is reached; it is also lower after a run of stays and rewards over the last 3 trials (a consolidated streak). At D1 it is lower after an a1 choice. At GO it is lower after a rewarded a1-S1 trial and when the policy favours a1 (graded choice logit). So, late in the episode, a streak of rewarded a1 choices keeps D1/GO well below baseline while D2 stays high once S1 is reached; an a2/S2 streak lowers D2. All terms are observed only (choice is the model logit at GO). Without the late-episode scaling, the same indicators give just 0.17 on dev. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.40, above the profile all-cues ceiling of 0.27 because the cues interact with episode time.
